en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Salma Bin Al Khattab, from Ali Bin Al Munzir Al Zayyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Whenever there was a Dirham with you, so buy the wheat with it, for the annihilation is in the flour’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Salmah ibn al-Khattab from Ali ibn al-Mundhir al-Zabbal from Muhammad ibn Fudayl who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If you have one dirham buy wheat with it; buying flour is destruction.’”
